verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs explicitly mention giving accountants direct access to the books and custom role-based access management, directly supporting the founder story of inviting an accountant with scoped permissions. However, evidence lacks detail on the specific invite workflow, granular permission scoping options, or independent/hands-on confirmation of how this works in practice. missing for 10: detailed accountant-invite workflow documentation, granularity of role-scoped permissions, independent user corroboration of the experience.
